## 1.0 Introduction

The goal of this project is to identify eoPRED score associations with sex chromosome DNA methylation. I will use two datasets of placentas. In this script I re-process the samples in the SPAH cohort so that the processing will match with the 450K Dataset. 

NOTE: When I first wrote these scripts I called the 450K Dataset the 'Discovery Cohort' and the SPAH Dataset the 'Validation Cohort'. You may still see objects named this way.

### 1.1 Packages

```{r packages, warning=F, message=F}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)

#load the probe information
probeInfo <- readRDS("//fs/teams/RobinsonLab/Hannah/05_Projects/SPAH/E. Sex and Environment Project [abandon]/02_Outputs/02_Variability/hg38_b5_EPIC_probeinfo.rds")
probeInfo <- probeInfo %>% mutate(Start_hg38 = as.numeric(Start_hg38))

chrXprobes <- probeInfo %>% filter(chr == "chrX")
chrYprobes <- probeInfo %>% filter(chr == "chrY")
autoProbes <- probeInfo %>% filter(!(chr %in% c("chrX", "chrY")))

set.seed(4815)

```

### 1.2 Data

```{r data}

spah_path <- "//fs/teams/RobinsonLab/Hannah/05_Projects/SPAH/"

metadata <- readRDS(paste0(spah_path,"C. Processing/02_Outputs/01_QC_Preprocessing/SPAH_metadata_ss_filtered.rds"))
dim(metadata) #493 x 162

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(Sex_Predic = as.factor(Sex_Predic)) 

```

## 2.0 Normalization

Performed previously for pathology project.

```{r betas-adj-das}

betas_adjdas <- readRDS(paste0(spah_path,"C. Processing/02_Outputs/03_XY_Processing/betas_adjdas.rds"))
dim(betas_adjdas) #865859 x 496

#filter to 493 samples
betas_adjdas <- betas_adjdas[, metadata$rgset_colnames]
dim(betas_adjdas) #865859 x 493

```

## 3.0 Probe Filtering

### 3.1 B5 Manifest

```{r b5-manifest}

#remove the bad b4 probes labeled in the MFG_Change_Flagged column
probeInfo_b5 <- probeInfo %>% filter(!MFG_Change_Flagged ==TRUE)
dim(probeInfo_b5) #864869  

table(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% probeInfo_b5$probeID)
b5_probes <- rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% probeInfo_b5$probeID
betas_adjdas <- betas_adjdas[b5_probes,] 
dim(betas_adjdas) #864869

```

### 3.2 Polymorphic & Cross-hybridizing

```{r non-specific-probes}

#read in the zhou mask object
zhou_mask <- read.delim(paste0(spah_path,"B. Data/B. Reference Data/EPIC.hg38.mask.tsv.gz")) #newer masking info
dim(zhou_mask) #865918

zhou_maskgeneral <- zhou_mask %>% filter(MASK_general) #save the MASK_general probes in a new object
dim(zhou_maskgeneral) #105454

table(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% zhou_maskgeneral$probeID) #105303 to remove

betas_adjdas<- betas_adjdas[!(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% zhou_maskgeneral$probeID),]
dim(betas_adjdas) #759566 probes

```

### 3.3 DetP

```{r detp}

detP <- readRDS(paste0(spah_path,"C. Processing/02_Outputs/01_QC_Preprocessing/detP.rds"))
dim(detP) #864869 x 510

detP <- detP [, metadata$rgset_colnames]
dim(detP) #x493

# rather than actually sex-stratifying for the detP probes I am going to change 
# all the female Y chromosome values to 0 so that they aren't considered for detP removal 
metadata_f <- metadata %>% filter(Sex_Predic == "XX")

f_detP <- detP #make an object where we will modifty the detP value in females 
f_detP[rownames(f_detP) %in% chrYprobes$probeID, colnames(f_detP) %in% metadata_f$rgset_colnames] <- 0
femaleYdetP <- f_detP[rownames(f_detP) %in% chrYprobes$probeID, colnames(f_detP) %in% metadata_f$rgset_colnames]
dim(femaleYdetP)
all(femaleYdetP == 0) #check this step worked

failed_detP <- f_detP > 0.01 #get a matrix of how many probes failed detP
failed_detP <- failed_detP [rownames(betas_adjdas),]

# create an logical matrix with which probes failed a check (true = fail)
# sum to see if a probe failed any checks (false + false = 0)
failed_probes <- failed_detP + is.na(betas_adjdas) 
failed_probes <- failed_probes > 0 # >0 means failed any of the checks

table(rowSums(failed_probes) >= (ncol(failed_probes)*0.05)) #1152 probes to remove

# index them for removal
badprobes <- data.frame(probebad <- rowSums(failed_probes) >= ncol(failed_probes)*0.05) %>%
  filter(probebad == TRUE)
dim(badprobes) #1152

## Remove the probes from the betas object
table(row.names(betas_adjdas) %in% rownames(badprobes))
betas_adjdas <- betas_adjdas[!(row.names(betas_adjdas) %in% rownames(badprobes)),]
dim(betas_adjdas) #758414

```

### 3.4 Additional X/Y Probes

Inkster et al. 2023 identified additional probes on the X and Y that should be removed from analysis because they overlapped with the XTR, repetitive elements, or were in cancer testis gene promoters. Here I will remove those probes.

```{r bad-x-y-probes}

#load additional X and Y annotation info
chrXY_ext <- read.csv(paste0(spah_path,"B. Data/B. Reference Data/Inkster_extended_XY_probe_annotation.csv"),header = T, fileEncoding="UTF-8-BOM")

bad_xy_probes <- chrXY_ext %>% filter(MASK_X_transposed_region == TRUE |
                                        MASK_AnyRepetitive == TRUE)
dim(bad_xy_probes) #726

table(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% bad_xy_probes$probeID) #481

#remove probes
betas_adjdas <- betas_adjdas [!(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% bad_xy_probes$probeID),]
dim(betas_adjdas) #757933 probes

table(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% autoProbes$probeID) #741574 
table(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% chrXprobes$probeID) #16070
table(rownames(betas_adjdas) %in% chrYprobes$probeID) #289 

```

## 5.0 Save Objects & Conclusion

We ended up with 493 placentas and 757,659 probes (n=15,796 chrX, n=289 chrY). In the next script I will perform PCA, look for associations with sex in this dataset, and look for DNAme on the X and Y associated with eoPRED score.

```{r save}

saveRDS(betas_adjdas, here::here("02_Outputs/02_SPAH_Proc/val_cohort_betas_adjdas.RDS"))
saveRDS(metadata, here::here("02_Outputs/02_SPAH_Proc/val_cohort_metadata.RDS"))

```
